_comment: S3DIS indoor rooms, 13 classes. Reproduces the released run (logs/20260818_003229,
block_mode chunk is the partition that produced the record and the one
evaluate_full.py --mode chunk scores with, so training and evaluation split the cloud
identically: voxelize at room_grid, KD-split the voxels into cores of at most core_max,
give each core a halo ring of unsupervised context. Verified to rebuild the released
chunk_s3dis cache exactly -- same block count, feature width and core sizes.
Do NOT switch this to column mode: that is a different builder (full-resolution
overlapping columns) and does not reproduce these numbers.
